name: Pack Attack (Teamwork, Combat)
body:
You and your allies coordinate attacks to keep your opponent off guard.

Benefit: If an ally with this feat is flanking an opponent whom you threaten, you are also considered to be flanking that opponent.

Special: This feat may be taken by animals.
